summary: Scott Hanselman, VP at Microsoft and GitHub, discusses how AI coding agents are changing software engineering and what still matters for developers. The episode covers treating AI like an untrusted contributor, the importance of fundamentals and junior hires, and building real personal projects.
topics: AI transitions and history of programmer panic
AI overuse as 'caffeine' and the slop cannon

Fundamentals and communication for new developers
